series.name: Veyron / Axpert King / AEROX / VM-II (Voltronic-class numeric 01–59 + W-codes)
series.notes: Inverex-badged Voltronic-platform units: Veyron II / Veyron IV, Axpert King, AEROX, VM-II Premium. Numeric fault 01–09/10/11/51–59 + warnings W01–W07/W10/W15 from Inverex-branded manuals (AEROX, Veyron IV, King, VM-II) cross-checked against Voltronic OEM manuals. Display: LCD + red FAULT LED + beep patterns on warnings. Veyron II Premium manual p.31 has a Fault Reference section — rows NOT extracted (Scribd block) — expected to match this Voltronic set but unconfirmed for Veyron II specifically. Never cite unlabeled Growatt/Must blogs as Inverex. Reset: AC input off → 2–5 min → on (DC strings isolated for DC work).

meaning.en: Cooling fan is locked while inverter is off — fan did not spin at start.
meaning.ur: Inverter off hone par cooling fan lock hai — start par fan nahi ghuma.

solutions.en: Power off and unplug the unit before touching the fan
solutions.ur: Fan ko chhoone se pehle power off karke plug nikal lein

solutions.en: Turn the fan blade by hand to free it, remove any wire or dust holding it and check the fan connector is seated
solutions.ur: Fan ka patta haath se ghuma kar azaad karein, rukne wali taar/dhool hatayein aur connector sahi laga hon dekhein

solutions.en: Do not force the unit to run with a jammed fan; replace the fan if it does not spin freely
solutions.ur: Fan atka hona par unit ko zabardasti na chalayein; fan azaad na ghoome to use badlein

source.title: Inverex Axpert King 3.2/5.2KW manual (Voltronic OEM)

meaning.ur: Andar ka component temperature ≈100°C se upar.

solutions.en: Power off and let the unit cool down completely before cleaning
solutions.ur: Power off karke saaf karne se pehle unit ko mukammal thanda hone dein

solutions.en: Clean the vents and heatsink, blow out the dust and confirm both fans run while the unit is on
solutions.ur: Vent aur heatsink saaf karein, dhool nikalein aur unit ON hone par dono fan chalne confirm karein

solutions.en: Restart once after cooling; if it heats up again, reduce the load and have a technician check the fans and thermal sensor
solutions.ur: Thanda hone ke baad ek baar restart karein; dobara garmi aaye to load kam karwa kar technician se fan aur thermal sensor check karwayein

source.title: Voltronic Axpert MKS II / VM IV OEM manuals (platform cross-check)

meaning.en: Battery voltage above maximum charge limit.
meaning.ur: Battery voltage maximum charge limit se upar.

solutions.en: Stop charging immediately and power off if the battery is hot, leaking or swollen
solutions.ur: Foran charge rok dein aur battery garam, leakage wali ya phooli ho to power off karein

solutions.en: Compare the charge voltage setting with the battery type and lower it to the battery maker's value
solutions.ur: Charge voltage setting ko battery type se milayein aur battery wali company ki value par utarein

solutions.en: Check each battery link with a meter for a weak cell and have a technician check the bank if voltage stays high
solutions.ur: Meter se har battery link par weak cell check karein; voltage zyada hi rahe to technician se bank check karwayein

source.title: Voltronic Axpert MKS II / VM IV OEM manuals (platform cross-check)

meaning.ur: Battery voltage cut-off se neeche.

solutions.en: Do not deep-cycle the bank further; check it for heat or swelling before charging
solutions.ur: Battery ko aur deep-cycle na karein; charge se pehle uski garmi ya phoolna check karein

solutions.en: Charge from PV or grid if safe, tighten the loose battery links and watch the SOC rise
solutions.ur: Safe ho to PV/grid se charge karein, dhile battery link tight karein aur dekhein ke SOC barh raha hai

solutions.en: If the voltage does not recover, have a technician test the old bank and replace the weak batteries
solutions.ur: Voltage wapas na aaye to technician se purani battery test karwa kar kamzor cell badlein

source.title: Voltronic Axpert MKS II / VM IV OEM manuals (platform cross-check)

meaning.en: AC output shorted or converter over-temperature.
meaning.ur: AC output short ya converter over-temperature.

solutions.en: Treat all DC and AC terminals as live — lethal voltages present even with breakers off
solutions.ur: Tamam DC aur AC terminals ko live samajhein — breakers off hone par bhi jaanleva voltage maujood

solutions.en: Disconnect AC load; insulation test; technician before re-energize
solutions.ur: AC load disconnect karein; insulation test; re-energize se pehle technician

source.title: Voltronic Axpert MKS II / VM IV OEM manuals (platform cross-check)

meaning.ur: Inverter output voltage limits se bahar.

causes.ur: Regulation ke liye load bohat kam/zyada

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before taking any measurement
solutions.ur: Koi bhi measurement lene se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein

solutions.en: Measure the output with a meter and check the load is neither too light nor too heavy for regulation
solutions.ur: Output ko meter se napein aur check karein ke load regulation ke liye zyada halka ya bhaari na ho

solutions.en: If the voltage is still out of range, have a technician check the feedback/sense circuit and the power stage
solutions.ur: Voltage phir bhi range se bahir ho to technician se feedback/sense circuit aur power stage check karwayein

source.title: Voltronic Axpert MKS II / VM IV OEM manuals (platform cross-check)

meaning.ur: Load ≥110% raha jab tak time-out nahi hua.

causes.en: Load close to or above rating
causes.ur: Load rating ke qareeb ya usse zyada

causes.en: Heavy motor or AC start current

solutions.en: Reduce the load below 100% of the rating before restarting the unit
solutions.ur: Unit ko restart karne se pehle load ko 100% rating se neeche karein

solutions.en: Compare the nameplate rating with the measured load on a clamp meter and switch off non-essential loads
solutions.ur: Nameplate rating ko clamp meter se naape hue load se milayein aur zaroori se bahir load band karein

solutions.en: Start heavy loads one by one; if the trip returns at normal load, have a technician check the current sensor
solutions.ur: Bhaari load ek ek karke start karein; mamooli load par bhi trip wapas aaye to technician se current sensor check karwayein

source.title: Voltronic Axpert MKS II / VM IV OEM manuals (platform cross-check)

meaning.ur: DC bus par voltage zyada.

solutions.en: Treat all DC and AC terminals as live — lethal voltages present even with breakers off
solutions.ur: Tamam DC aur AC terminals ko live samajhein — breakers off hone par bhi jaanleva voltage maujood

solutions.en: Check series module count vs max DC; technician
solutions.ur: Series modules vs max DC check karein; technician

source.title: Voltronic Axpert MKS II / VM IV OEM manuals (platform cross-check)

meaning.ur: DC bus soft-start sequence fail.

solutions.en: Power off and wait for the DC bus to discharge; do not restart again and again
solutions.ur: Power off karke DC bus ka discharge hone dein; baar baar restart na karein

solutions.en: After isolating, use a meter to check the precharge circuit, relay and DC bus for a short
solutions.ur: Isolate karke meter se precharge circuit, relay aur DC bus par short check karein

solutions.en: If the bus will not charge, have a technician replace the failed relay or precharge part
solutions.ur: Bus charge na ho to technician se kharab relay ya precharge part badalwayein

source.title: Inverex Axpert King 3.2/5.2KW manual (Voltronic OEM)

meaning.ur: PV input current limit se upar.

causes.ur: String config ya MPPT ka masla
Zyada parallel strings set kar di gayin
Charger mein MPPT tracking ka masla

solutions.en: Turn off the PV DC breaker or isolator before checking the strings
solutions.ur: String check karne se pehle PV ka DC breaker ya isolator band karein

solutions.en: Verify the number of parallel strings matches the inverter limit and that no extra strings were added
solutions.ur: Check karein ke parallel strings inverter ki limit ke mutabiq hain aur koi extra string judi to nahi

solutions.en: Measure the string current with a meter; if it is within range but the trip returns, have a technician check the MPPT stage
solutions.ur: Meter se string current napein; range ke andar hone par bhi trip wapas aaye to technician se MPPT stage check karwayein

source.title: APT VEYRON IV 3.2KW manual p.43 fault table

meaning.ur: PV input voltage limit se upar.

causes.en: Array Voc above inverter max PV
causes.ur: Array ka Voc inverter ke max PV se zyada
Sardi mein module ka voltage barh jana

solutions.en: Turn off the PV isolator first and let the array cool; PV wires stay live in daylight
solutions.ur: Pehle PV isolator band karein aur array ko thanda hone dein; din ke waqt PV wires bhi live rehti hain

solutions.en: Count the modules in each series string and compare the total Voc with the nameplate max PV Voc
solutions.ur: Har series string mein modules gin kar total Voc ko nameplate max PV Voc se milayein

solutions.en: Remove modules from the string until Voc is within limit; if it is still high, have a technician check the input stage
solutions.ur: Voc limit ke andar aane tak string se modules hatayein; phir bhi zyada rahe to technician se input stage check karwayein

source.title: APT VEYRON IV 3.2KW manual p.43 fault table

meaning.ur: Power-stage over-current ya surge trip.

solutions.en: Treat all DC and AC terminals as live — lethal voltages present even with breakers off
solutions.ur: Tamam DC aur AC terminals ko live samajhein — breakers off hone par bhi jaanleva voltage maujood

solutions.en: Power off; do not keep restarting — qualified technician diagnosis required
solutions.ur: Power off; baar baar restart na karein — qualified technician diagnosis zaroori

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)

meaning.ur: DC bus par voltage kam.

causes.ur: PV input kamzor ho ya shadow pada ho

solutions.en: Check meters/app: grid voltage/frequency, PV Voc within label, battery SOC
solutions.ur: Meters/app check karein: grid voltage/frequency, PV Voc label mutabiq, battery SOC

solutions.en: Power cycle: switch unit OFF → wait 2–5 min (DC and AC breakers off) → ON
solutions.ur: Power cycle: unit OFF → 2–5 minute wait (DC aur AC breakers OFF) → ON

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)

meaning.ur: Inverter output soft-start fail.

solutions.en: Power off and isolate before retrying; do not keep restarting the unit
solutions.ur: Dobara koshish se pehle power off karke isolate karein; unit ko baar baar restart na karein

solutions.en: Disconnect heavy loads such as motors and the AC, then start the inverter on a light load
solutions.ur: Motor/AC jaise bhaari load alag karke, halka load par inverter start karein

solutions.en: If it still fails to start, have a technician check the output stage and relays and replace the faulty part
solutions.ur: Phir bhi start na ho to technician se output stage aur relay check karwa kar kharab part badlein

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)

title.en: Over DC voltage in AC output / output unbalance
title.ur: AC output mein DC voltage zyada / output barabar nahi

meaning.en: DC component in AC output or output imbalance.
meaning.ur: AC output mein DC component ya output imbalance.

causes.ur: Output stage ka device kamzor ho gaya

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before measuring the output
solutions.ur: Output napein se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein

solutions.en: Measure the DC component on the output with a meter and check the load for a leakage path
solutions.ur: Meter se output par DC component napein aur load mein leakage path check karein

solutions.en: Have a technician check the feedback circuit and output bridge devices and replace the failed part
solutions.ur: Technician se feedback circuit aur output bridge device check karwa kar kharab part badlein

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)

meaning.ur: Current sensor/CT fail.

causes.ur: CT/sensor khula ya kharab ho gaya

solutions.en: Power off and isolate before checking the sensor wiring
solutions.ur: Sensor wiring check karne se pehle power off karke isolate karein

solutions.en: Check the CT/sensor connector and wiring for looseness or damage and compare the readings across phases
solutions.ur: CT/sensor connector aur wiring ke dhile ya kharab hona dekhein aur phases ki readings compare karein

solutions.en: Replace the current sensor or CT if its reading stays wrong
solutions.ur: Reading ghalat hi rahe to current sensor ya CT badlein

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)

meaning.ur: Inverter output voltage limit se neeche.

causes.ur: Load regulation range se zyada bhaari

solutions.en: Power off and isolate AC before measuring the output voltage
solutions.ur: Output voltage napein se pehle power off karke AC isolate karein

solutions.en: Measure the output voltage with a meter under a normal load and confirm the load is within the rating
solutions.ur: Mamoomi load par meter se output voltage napein aur load rating ke andar hai confirm karein

solutions.en: If the voltage stays low, have a technician check the regulation/feedback circuit and the output stage
solutions.ur: Voltage kam hi rahe to technician se regulation/feedback circuit aur output stage check karwayein

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)

meaning.en: PV open-circuit voltage above inverter limit — reduce series modules.
meaning.ur: PV open-circuit voltage inverter limit se upar — series modules kam karein.

causes.ur: Series string allowed se zyada lambi

solutions.en: Turn off the PV isolator before working on the string
solutions.ur: String par kaam se pehle PV isolator band karein

solutions.en: Count the modules per string and add up the Voc against the inverter max PV Voc
solutions.ur: Har string ke modules gin kar total Voc ko inverter ke max PV Voc se milayein

solutions.en: Reduce the modules per string until within limit and recheck the reading after connecting
solutions.ur: Limit ke andar aane tak har string se modules kam karein aur lagane ke baad reading dobara check karein

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)

title.ur: Fan atka hua hai jab unit ON ho (beep ×3/s)

meaning.en: Fan locked warning while unit ON — beep pattern ×3 per second.
meaning.ur: Unit ON par fan lock warning — beep ×3 har second.

causes.en: Fan blocked by dust or a wire
causes.ur: Fan dhool ya taar se atka hua

solutions.en: Switch the unit off first so the fan can be freed safely
solutions.ur: Fan azaad karne se pehle unit ko band karein

solutions.en: Remove the obstruction or dust by hand and spin the blade to confirm it turns freely
solutions.ur: Rokawat ya dhool haath se hatayein aur patta ghuma kar uska azaad ghoomna confirm karein

solutions.en: Restart the unit; if the fan still does not run, check its connector and replace the fan
solutions.ur: Unit restart karein; fan phir bhi na chale to uska connector check karke fan badlein

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)

title.en: High internal temperature (beep escalates near trip)
title.ur: Andar temperature zyada (trip ke qareeb beep barhta hai)

meaning.en: High internal temperature warning before F02 trip.
meaning.ur: F02 trip se pehle high temperature warning.

causes.ur: Filter aur heatsink block ho gaye
Aas paas ka temperature bohat zyada

solutions.en: Reduce the load and let the unit cool before cleaning it
solutions.ur: Load kam karein aur saaf karne se pehle unit ko thanda hone dein

solutions.en: Clean the filters, vents and heatsink and confirm the fans are running
solutions.ur: Filter, vent aur heatsink saaf karein aur fans ke chalne confirm karein

solutions.en: Improve the airflow around the unit; if the warning repeats, have a technician check the thermal sensor and fans
solutions.ur: Unit ke aas paas airflow behtar karein; warning dobara aaye to technician se thermal sensor aur fans check karwayein

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)

meaning.ur: Battery zyada charge hone ki warning.

causes.en: Battery type / charge V set wrong
causes.ur: Battery type ya charge V ghalat set hai
Battery bank kharab ho ya gassing kar rahi ho

solutions.en: Stop charging if the battery is hot or swollen and keep it ventilated
solutions.ur: Battery garam ya phooli ho to charge rok dein aur use khuli hawa mein rakhein

solutions.en: Check the charge voltage and battery type settings and correct them to the battery maker's values
solutions.ur: Charge voltage aur battery type setting check karke battery wali company ki values par theek karein

solutions.en: Have a technician measure the battery voltage while charging and test the bank for a weak cell
solutions.ur: Technician se charge karte waqt battery voltage naap kar bank mein weak cell test karwayein

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)

meaning.ur: Battery ka charge kam hai — warning.

causes.en: Load running on battery too long
causes.ur: Load bohat der se battery par chal raha
PV/grid battery ko charge nahi kar rahe

solutions.en: Shed heavy loads and charge the battery before it reaches the cut-off voltage
solutions.ur: Bhaari load utaar dein aur battery ke cut-off voltage se pehle use charge karein

solutions.en: Charge from PV during the day or from the grid where allowed and watch the SOC in the app
solutions.ur: Din mein PV se ya jahan ijazat ho grid se charge karein aur app mein SOC par nazar rakhein

solutions.en: If the SOC does not rise, check the battery links and fuses and have the weak bank tested
solutions.ur: SOC na barhe to battery link aur fuse check karein aur kamzor bank test karwayein

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)

meaning.en: Load approaching limit before F07 trip.
meaning.ur: F07 trip se pehle load limit ke qareeb.

causes.ur: Haal hi mein extra load jud gaya

solutions.en: Shed load below the rating before the F07 trip occurs
solutions.ur: F07 trip hone se pehle load ko rating se neeche utarein

solutions.en: Check the total running load with a clamp meter against the nameplate rating
solutions.ur: Clamp meter se chalte hue total load ko nameplate rating se milayein

solutions.en: Switch off non-essential loads and start motors one at a time
solutions.ur: Zaroori se bahir load band karein aur motor ek ek karke start karein

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)

title.ur: Output power kam ho raha hai (beep ×2/3s)

meaning.ur: Unit jaan bujh kar output power kam kar rahi (thermal/grid/PV).

causes.en: Thermal derate / grid limit / low PV
causes.ur: Thermal derate / grid limit / PV kam

solutions.en: Improve cooling; check grid/PV conditions
solutions.ur: Cooling behtar karein; grid/PV dekhein

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)

meaning.ur: PV production bohat kam (raat/zyada shadow).

solutions.en: Informational — clean panels; check strings after light
solutions.ur: Sirf maloomat — panels saaf karein; dhoop aane ke baad strings check karein

source.title: Inverex Axpert VM-II Premium 1.5K–6.2K manual (Voltronic OEM)
